LL-A3–LL-A5: all required finite transitions of admitted supported programs execute at their intended samples, including same-frame cascades and one-sample loops, without arbitrary musical-work quotas or mandatory interaction delays. 5. LL-A6–LL-A7: callback-reachable execution and failure paths remain allocation/reallocation/deallocation-free, nonblocking, lock/wait/I/O-free, and free from unbounded producer-chasing retries. Fixed storage, finite external admission, reliable owning returns, distinct admission/execution outcomes, generations, cancellation, stalls, disconnect, retirement, and teardown preserve ownership. Automatic musical progression does not require external command/completion credits.
6. LL-A8–LL-A10: implement the plan's stereo/configurable-audio-plus-MIDI recording/playback/seek/replacement/snapshot capabilities, exact-frame record-to-play without an unintended silent block, defined MIDI cleanup, and separate playback→FX→recording operations. Capture exhaustion preserves a truthful common prefix without aborting unrelated audio. Supported composites share the resolver and observation model. Required rendering is not throttled by background quotas or diagnostic limits; indexing, capture transactions, publication, and reclamation have explicit preparation/ownership/failure contracts.
7. LL-A11: independent reference/property tests, guarded native debug/release and Wasm paths, selected Miri/concurrency checks, offline/two-thread native hosts, Node/Chromium tests, and actual non-isolated offline/live AudioWorklet sessions provide evidence. Actual Web Audio output and transition/MIDI journals agree with native reference execution; worklet memory stays fixed. Failure canaries prove failures are detected. Performance evidence exposes actual workload and storage/timing costs without claiming guaranteed deadlines or unsupported speedups.

Applicable existing runtime/application gates remain green. Commit meaningful milestones, push the dedicated branch, open/update the PR, verify required CI on the final head, and inspect/address automated reviews through approval when available.
